The repair-003 Recorder ledger is incomplete and its scanner gate checks the wrong executable boundary. The child verifies and ledgers `src/recorder/scanner.ts`, but imports tracked `dist/recorder/scanner.js` at exhibit lines 240-247; the dist hash is merely recorded afterward and never compared to an immutable Git tuple. Thus `scannerHash` can remain true while the actually imported module drifts. The verifier only validates tuples that happen to be present (lines 2059-2069), so it cannot detect either omission.

Before import, resolve and record a full Git tuple for the actual tracked dist scanner, compare its worktree bytes to that tuple, and gate execution on it (retain the source tuple as an additional input). Record and verify every admitted immutable reference tuple even when an external source copy is selected, and add a completeness assertion derived from dispositions/reports/derivatives/scanner inputs rather than self-enumerating the ledger.
